title: 第24章 火工童子的选拔第25章 争夺名额
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神

刚回到外门，李安就看到赵管事召集了众多丹房的杂役弟子，似乎是在训话。
特别是看见赶来此地的自己之后，他更是满脸怒容地走过来，手中的马鞭挥动的噼啪作响。
李安瞥了一眼整齐站好的杂役弟子，他们身上大多有马鞭鞭打的痕迹，皮开肉绽，鲜血淋漓。
此刻，这些杂役弟子正幸灾乐祸地看向自己。
唯有周通有些担忧地想要上前开口。
这段时间赵管事不知抽什么封，对他们这些杂役越发严厉起来，一点小错都被揪着不放，硬要扣罚灵石。
李安一上午都没有看到人，这下情况可惨了。
只是，周通才抬脚走出了半步，又畏畏缩缩地抖了抖身子，缩回了队伍中。
赵管事冷酷无情，自己人微言轻，根本没有用，上去劝说，自己也是个挨鞭子的份。
李安如今的灵魂极为强大，只是一眼，就将众人的反应全都看在眼底。
不过他们有这样的反应也很正常，杂役弟子在宗门内过得苦，自然希望有人比他们过得更苦，他们的内心也就会平衡许多。
可惜，自己如今已然和他们彻底不同了。
当然，心中虽然这么想着，但李安脸上却是一副惶恐的模样，
“赵管事，今日不是我故意迟到，而是有了突破的契机，刚好突破到了炼气二层！”
李安说着，然后就散发出了炼气二层的灵气波动。
在修行了炼丹术后，加上体内灵气也提升到了七品上，李安对自身灵气的掌控和气息的释放，已经到了极为精妙的地步，忽悠赵管事这个炼气五层修士，并不困难。
随着李安释放的炼气二层气息弥漫开来。
刚刚还对李安一脸鄙夷的外门杂役弟子，全都是惊讶地微张着嘴巴。
炼气二层！

这李安分明是个五行废灵根，这么快就突破炼气二层呢？！
一些在丹房呆了几个月甚至一年多的杂役弟子，更是比吃了苍蝇还难受。
毕竟他们这些杂役弟子，大部分都是炼气一层。
炼气二层很少，炼气三层更是其中的佼佼者。
原本他们都觉得外门有李安垫底，怎么也轮不到自己一直在炼气一层。
可是，这才过去了多久？
他居然突破了？！
五行废灵根不是说几十年苦修，都难以突破到炼气二层吗？
可是从李安身上散发出的气息来看，他的确是突破到了炼气二层。
这样的灵气威压，根本做不得假！
原本气势汹汹的赵管事，感受到李安那迎面而来的气息，手中扬起的马鞭暂时停下，有些惊愕地望着李安。
“炼气二层？你真的突破了？”
虽然炼气二层在外门依旧算不得什么，可是李安的灵根很不好，他能突破，大大超出了赵管事的预料。
如此短的时间就突破到炼气二层，这说明李安是个可造之材啊！
“虽然事出有因，可是我只看结果，不看过程，你上午没到就是没到，鞭子免了，这个月的灵石暂且扣下，以儆效尤。”
短暂的迟疑之后，赵管事放下了手中的马鞭，但也克扣了李安的灵石。

As soon as he returned to the outer gate, Li An saw Manager Zhao summoning many handyman disciples from the alchemy room, seemingly giving lectures.
Especially after seeing himself coming here, he walked over with an angry look on his face, the riding crop in his hand crackling.
Li An glanced at the handyman disciples who were standing neatly. Most of them had marks from riding whips on their bodies, with their skin torn and flesh dripping with blood.
At this moment, these handyman disciples were looking at themselves with gloating joy.
Only Zhou Tong was worried and wanted to step forward and speak.
During this time, Manager Zhao didn't know what kind of seal to draw, and he became more and more strict with the handymen like them. He would not let go of any small mistakes and insisted on deducting spiritual stones.
Li An didn't see anyone all morning, and the situation was dire now.
However, Zhou Tong only took half a step forward, shook his body timidly, and retracted into the team.
Manager Zhao is cold and ruthless, and his words are of no use at all. If he goes up to persuade, he will be whipped.
Li An's soul is extremely powerful now, and he can see all the reactions of everyone with just one glance.
However, it is normal for them to have such a reaction. The handyman disciples are living a hard life in the sect, so they naturally hope that someone will have a harder time than them, and their hearts will be more balanced.
Unfortunately, I am completely different from them now.
Of course, even though he was thinking this, Li An had a look of fear on his face.
"Manager Zhao, it's not that I was late on purpose today, but I had a chance to make a breakthrough, and I happened to break through to the second level of Qi Refining!"
Li An said, and then emitted the spiritual energy fluctuations of the second level of Qi Refining.
After practicing alchemy and raising the spiritual energy in his body to the seventh level, Li An's control of his own spiritual energy and the release of his breath have reached an extremely sophisticated level. It is not difficult to fool Guanshi Zhao, a fifth-level monk in Qi refining.
As Li An released the second level of Qi Refining, the aura filled the air.
The outer disciples who had looked down upon Li An just now all had their mouths slightly open in surprise.
Second level of Qi refining!
This Li An is obviously a five-element waste spiritual root, how can he break through the second level of Qi refining so quickly? !
Some handyman disciples who had stayed in the alchemy room for several months or even more than a year felt even worse than eating flies.
After all, most of these handyman disciples are at the first level of Qi Refining.
There are very few second level Qi Refining Levels, and the third level Qi Refining Level is the best among them.
Originally, they all thought that with Li An at the bottom of the outer sect, it was not their turn to be on the first level of Qi Refining.
But, how long has it been since then?
He actually broke through? !
Doesn’t it mean that the Five Elements Wasted Spiritual Roots cannot break through to the second level of Qi Refining even after decades of hard training?
But judging from the aura emanating from Li An's body, he had indeed broken through to the second level of Qi Refining.
Such spiritual pressure cannot be faked!
Manager Zhao, who was originally aggressive, felt Li An's oncoming aura. He temporarily stopped raising the riding whip in his hand and looked at Li An with some surprise.
"Second level of Qi refining? Have you really made a breakthrough?"
Although the second level of Qi Refining is still nothing in the outer sect, Li An's spiritual roots are very bad. His ability to break through greatly exceeded Manager Zhao's expectations.
Breaking through to the second level of Qi Refining in such a short period of time shows that Li An is a talented person!
"Although things happen for a reason, I only look at the results and not the process. If you didn't arrive in the morning, you didn't arrive. The whip will be waived. This month's spiritual stones will be temporarily withheld as a warning to others."
After a brief hesitation, Manager Zhao put down the riding crop in his hand, but also withheld Li An's spirit stone.
